newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both dollar and sterling on Monday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.374 to the dollar from 20.4745 last Friday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.0155 to sterling from 33.185 last Friday.

Forex dealers said that the rupee's fixing was in line with the weakening of dollar and sterling in international foreign exchange markets in the last few days. "The surge of yen has provoked the dollar's fall," they added.
Dealers said that the local market was quiet as hard currency demand from importers was subdued.
